creator.title: Glassy Hair at Home: My Surprise Product Reveal

sections.label: Hook
sections.message: Get ready to achieve glassy hair at home with a surprise product that's about to change your hair care routine!

sections.label: Promise
sections.message: I'll show you how to use this affordable product to transform your hair from dull to dazzling, with a simple and easy-to-follow demonstration.

sections.label: Proof
sections.message: Watch as I apply the product and wait for the magic to happen, with a before-and-after comparison that will leave you amazed at the results.

sections.label: Payoff
sections.message: The outcome is nothing short of stunning, with my hair looking healthier, shinier, and more vibrant than ever before, all thanks to this incredible product.

sections.label: Call to action
sections.message: Now it's your turn to try it out and share your own glassy hair transformation with me, using this product that's perfect for all hair types and styles.

dos: Keep teaching. The steps, the product, what it costs: teaching is what gets saved.
Keep the warmth: your voice over the clip, a story, a question.
Keep it bright and sharp, face in frame.
Keep talking to one viewer: 'you', one question, your face, one ask at the end.
Match the caption to the reel: one topic per post.
donts: Don't let 24–43 s sit still; one cut or a second reveal there.
Don't let the voice level swing; record close to the mic and keep the music under the voice.
Don't open with a plain statement; make the first line a question, a dare or a number.
Don't run past a minute without a second hook; this one runs 73 s.
